# Open Klippah

> Open Klippah is an open-source AI video clipper that turns long videos into
> captioned, vertical short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram
> Reels, and similar platforms.

## Canonical resources

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH): source code,
  setup instructions, architecture, license, and contribution history.
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH/blob/main/docs/setup.md):
  Docker-first installation and first-run checklist.
- [Configuration guide](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH/blob/main/docs/configuration.md):
  providers, operating modes, and environment variables.
- [API reference](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH/blob/main/docs/api-reference.md):
  backend routes, API keys, admin, and billing endpoints.
- [MCP server guide](https://github.com/aiwithenoch/OPEN-KLIPPAH/blob/main/mcp/README.md):
  use Open Klippah from Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

## Key capabilities

- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- YouTube URL and uploaded-file inputs.
- Face-aware 9:16 vertical reframing.
- Word-synced animated captions and caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Self-hosting with Docker Compose and configurable deployment infrastructure.
- Support for configured hosted language-model providers or Ollama.
- Transcription via AssemblyAI (default), local Whisper, or YouTube captions.
- REST API with per-user API keys, and an MCP server for AI clients.
- No watermark on exported clips.

## Important qualifications

- Virality scores prioritize candidates; they do not guarantee audience performance.
- The source code is free, but self-hosters provide their own infrastructure and
  any paid transcription or model-provider usage.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- No public Open Klippah hosting, App Store listing, or Product Hunt listing is
  assumed by this repository. Operators must publish only verified deployment
  URLs.
